column1: # Deliberate copies of Z9X files in the Play 6 port, checked by
# tools/play6/check_forks.py (check F). One row per copy, tab-separated, paths relative to gsi/:
#   play6 path <TAB> Z9X origin <TAB> sha256 of the origin at fork time <TAB> note
# A row is added when the copy is made. When F reports that an origin changed: review the Z9X change,
# port what applies to the Play 6 copy, then write the origin's new sha256 here (this file only).
# Synced copies (apps/common/sync.sh) are not forks and are not listed.

column4: note

Play 6 class of the same name (plan 2.4 not shared): facade on Play6Gmpf / Play6Gmpf2, start gate, p6-hal / p6-long / p6-motor; the Z9X HalController part folded in origin 2026-10-30 (Z9X 1.0.8 parity keystone item 2): 585 ON is no longer refused on a ceiling mount; the Play 6 never had that rule (Play6PanelController OQ 14), nothing to port. (2026-10-31 Z9X zoom exit AF then panel: runAfterAutofocus over AfCardOverlay; the Play 6 has no AF card and no optical zoom, nothing to port) (2026-10-31 Z9X panel back on AF end without a card: runAfterAutofocus doc only, the logic is in AfCardOverlay / AfAfter; the Play 6 has no AF card, nothing to port) (2026-11-04 Play 6 only, not in the origin: the hall AF busy window follows 330 AutoFocusing start / end and 5, 2, 18; the stock fine-tune notice on 18 "AF_Success_Into_Adjust" without the starry sky lens; rules in P6AfRules) 2026-11-26: the core Hal's readNow (lumen-hdmi HdmiAudio) has nothing to port, the Play 6 recipe takes no lumen-hdmi.

fork (plan 2.7): Android sleep only (no lamp-only standby), the Z9X PowerUi wiring folded in 2026-11-26 cec-parity-1126: the gmpf power key sleeps through SleepSource (CEC frames in the stock order); the Play 6 recipe has no lumen-hdmi and no lumen-cec, so Play6PowerKey keeps its own goToSleep (reviewed with cd52777cc), nothing more to port. 2026-11-26 power-general-1126: the short press and the hold are the shared PowerKeyPress (the setting Short press of the power key), ported to Play6PowerKey in b40ab5b75.

fork (2026-11-12 lamp.off): the Play 6 light calls of the shared Turn off screen (org.lumen.menu.LampOff): stock xgimi.api.version 324 sends setScreenOnOff (IGmpf 195) through Lamp.off / Lamp.on, not the Z9X setScreenOnOffWithAction

Play 6 class of the same name (t19, docs/play6/impl/setup-design.md): install (hal on every IGmpf connect, af 150 ms after the AF focus events, through the Play 6 Hal facade), remote(Context); no kst event (the 2 Hz hal_state poll covers it)
fork (plan 2.7): 326-byte wire, 1920x1080 panel space, no built-in full frame

fork (plan 2.7, step 12): the XGIMI vendor-app list plus the Z9X values without the KEYCODE_POWER items and config_maxUiWidth; cached processes 8 (Z9X 10); config_useDevInputEventForAudioJack (Play 6 only). F: assistant and the dream component equal the Z9X; the HDMI-CEC defaults moved to the generated lumen_cec.xml of both (tools/devices/cec_defaults.py, cec-standby-stock)
fork (plan 2.7, step 14, D 6.4): arm copy run in compose's container; ISA details and dex2oat read from the base's webview dexpreopt.sh

fork (plan 2.7, step 13): only the BT LE privacy line; further lines only after test A7 (2026-11-05 Z9X 1.0.9: comments only (no requirement item number, no research path); nothing to port, the Play 6 copy keeps its own comments; 2026-11-15 volume-z9x-play6: persist.bluetooth.disableabsvol true at early-boot, ported (the Play 6 copy had its own false line, now true, its own comment))

fork (plan 2.7, step 16, plan 1.3): Play6KstPoint 1920x1080, IGmpf2 125 bracket (abort before any IGmpf write), stock game mutex; no 158, no IGmpf2 setKstPrepare, no full-frame reset (O3, B9) origin 2026-10-30 (Z9X 1.0.8 parity keystone items 7, 13): hold-OK reset through 207(0) and 18 setKstPrepare ON again; the Play 6 fork has neither (no setKstPrepare, no full-frame reset, O3 / B9), nothing to port.; Z9X 1.0.8 game lock (KstGameLock, 55/666) not ported: the Play 6 keeps its own stock game mutex (2026-11-05 (Z9X 1.0.9 prep) reviewed, not ported, Play 6 unchanged: Z9X stock 3D refusal and 194 push-pull screen state around the screen (G0082 rules)) (2026-11-12 the Z9X GmpfClient value enums are top-level types: nothing to port, the Play 6 has its own HAL clients) (2026-11-12 shared gmpf clients: only the hal types of the Z9X origin moved to top-level (ReplyException, HdmiSignal, OutputTimingInfo, NuiNotReadyException); nothing to port, the Play 6 copy uses Play6Gmpf)

fork (plan 2.7, step 16): Play6Gmpf.manualFocus (300 with 17 / 1 / 0 / 2), p6-motor via the Hal facade, behind the start gate origin 2026-10-30 (Z9X 1.0.8 parity focus item 10): exitForAutofocus ported (no manualFocus(2) when the window closes for an AF). (2026-11-04 Play 6 only, not in the origin: exit() sends manualFocus(2) only if something may be moving, as stock FocusAdjust; the Play 6 vendor has no 17 mode to leave) (2026-11-12 the Z9X GmpfClient value enums are top-level types: nothing to port, the Play 6 has its own HAL clients) (2026-11-12 shared gmpf clients: only the hal types of the Z9X origin moved to top-level (ReplyException, HdmiSignal, OutputTimingInfo, NuiNotReadyException); nothing to port, the Play 6 copy uses Play6Gmpf) (2026-11-13 Play 6 only, not in the origin: startNow sends manualFocus(1 / 0) before the manual_moving commit through P6AfRules.startMove, so the disk write no longer delays the first motor step, and a commit that fails stops the move at once)

same class name, own Play 6 body, not a copy (t14, first; the Z9X 1.0.3 class of 2026-10-13 is its port to GmpfClient): one HDMI port (ARC, HW1), 698 / 659 / 696 through the Play 6 Hal facade (check H HDMI_PATH) origin 2026-10-21 (Z9X 1.0.4): HdmiVolume start / stop on each decision, which this class already did since t15, nothing to port. (2026-11-12 shared gmpf clients: only the hal types of the Z9X origin moved to top-level (ReplyException, HdmiSignal, OutputTimingInfo, NuiNotReadyException); nothing to port, the Play 6 copy uses Play6Gmpf) (2026-11-15 volume-z9x-play6: the Z9X HdmiSource no longer starts or stops a volume follower; the Play 6 body drops its HdmiVolume calls the same, diagnostics show lumen-audio StockVolume.describe)

fork (Google test edition, build_test.sh --gms, docs/play6/impl/t19-gms.md): the same elements (sign_play6.py gms checks them), Play 6 comment; installed as /system/etc/sysconfig/lumen-gapps.xml of the -gms image only

P3 item 21 (2026-10-20): card, keys and the edge grid from the Z9X; Play 6 calls (IGmpf 121 / 117 / 116 / 118 / 141 / 120, IGmpf2 125 through Play6AdjustSession), no IGmpf2 18, no 158 (2026-11-12 the Z9X GmpfClient value enums are top-level types: nothing to port, the Play 6 has its own HAL clients) 2026-11-26 one-projector-10: its edge grid became the core class EdgeGrid, which the Play 6 card uses too (its own copy is gone); nothing to port.

fork (Lumen 1.0.6, stock parity 2026-10-24): scancode 184 (the remote's shortcut key) -> TV_SATELLITE_SERVICE for the ambient speaker; everything else as the Z9X file (2026-11-12 the remote's gear hold, stock MENU 127 / 139 = KEYCODE_TV_MEDIA_CONTEXT_MENU, Z9xKeys.GEAR_HOLD: ported) 2026-11-26: the Z9X 184 became TV_RADIO_SERVICE (Remote buttons); the Play 6 keeps TV_SATELLITE_SERVICE for its ambient speaker, the rest equal.
